First, rewrite the order of the variables in the usual way:

$$
T:\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}-3x+9y \\ 6x+y\end{bmatrix}

We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot \begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-3x+9y \\ 6x+y\end{bmatrix}.

$$

$$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 9 \\ 6 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$
